Spent the afternoon at the Greenville County Memorial Day ceremony, which commemorated the 250th anniversary of the Revolutionary War. 

It was a fitting tribute to the patriots - spanning generations - that gave their lives in service of our great nation and in defense of our freedom.

Very sad to hear of the passing of my good friend Doug McCain, the oldest son of Senator McCain. Doug was an American Patriot, a Navy pilot like his father, and had an outstanding career as an airline pilot. Doug loved his country, his wonderful family and will be missed by us all. His passing was way too soon. Rest in Peace my friend.

President Trump’s most recent proposal requiring expansion of the Abraham Accords as part of a negotiated settlement to the Iran conflict is simply brilliant and would result in the most significant change in the Middle East in thousands of years. 

With Saudi Arabia and others like Pakistan making peace with Israel, the region will know a level of stability never dreamed of before President Trump and will eventually lead to regional integration making the Middle East a powerhouse for economic o

On Memorial Day, we pause as a nation to honor the brave men and women who gave their lives in defense of our freedom. Across generations, more than a million Americans have made the ultimate sacrifice so that our country might endure and our values might prevail.

Their courage secured the liberties we too often take for granted. Their sacrifice binds us together in gratitude and solemn remembrance.

Sen. Lindsey Graham signaled strong support for President Donald Trump's emerging Iran strategy Sunday, arguing that any long-term agreement with Tehran should be tied to a dramatic expansion of the Abraham Accords that would include Saudi Arabia and other major Muslim nations normalizing relations with Israel.

newsmax.com/newsfront/lindse…

If in fact as a result of these negotiations to end the Iranian conflict, our Arab and Muslim allies in the region agreed to join the Abraham Accords, it would make this agreement one of the most consequential in the history of the Middle East. 

Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Pakistan joining the Abraham Accords would be beyond transformative for the region and world. It is a brilliant move by President Trump. 

To Saudi Arabia and others: Now is the time to be bold for the future of a new Middle Eas

If it is perceived in the region that a deal with Iran allows the regime to survive and become more powerful over time, we will have poured gasoline on the conflicts in Lebanon and Iraq. 

A deal that is perceived to allow Iran to survive and possess the ability to control the Strait in the future will put Hezbollah in Lebanon and the Shia militias in Iraq on steroids.

If a deal is struck to end the Iranian conflict because it is believed that the Strait of Hormuz cannot be protected from Iranian terrorism and Iran still possesses the capability to destroy major Gulf oil infrastructure, then Iran will be perceived as being a dominate force requiring a diplomatic solution. 

This combination of Iran being perceived as having the ability to terrorize the Strait in perpetuity and the ability the inflict massive damage to Gulf oil infrastructure is a major shift o
Good analysis of the Strait of Hormuz. foxnews.com/video/6396380909…

Very disappointed to learn that President Trump’s policy expanding red snapper season has been blocked by a federal court in DC. While this setback is frustrating, we will not be deterred. 

This decision denies South Carolina fishermen of their right to enjoy our waters and will hurt charter fishing businesses along the coast. Therefore, I will continue fighting to expand access to red snapper fishing up and down the South Carolina coast.

Very excited that Kevin Warsh has now been sworn in as the new Chairman of the Federal Reserve. He’s the right man at the right time with unparalleled and unquestioned academic and real world experience involving the nation’s economy. I know he’ll be a steady hand at the Fed as we navigate the challenges of the 21st century. 

Well done, President Trump

Kevin Warsh is officially sworn in as the 17th Chairman of the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve

Cuba Libre.

Very sad to hear of the passing of Kyle Busch. He was one of the strongest forces and voices in NASCAR. 

He will be missed by all who loved the sport and legions of family and friends.

We are saddened and heartbroken to share the news of the passing of Kyle Busch, a two-time Cup champion and one of our sport's greatest and fiercest drivers. He was 41 years old.

I completely understand that she needs to be with her family as her husband is going through a very difficult time. I will be praying for good outcomes.
